title: On a cyclic structure of generators modulo primes
summary: In this paper, we introduce a new notion called the \textit{set of missing generators} $\mathcal{M}(g)$ for a generator (or primitive element) $g$ of the cyclic group $\mathbb{Z}_p^*$, where $p$ is an odd prime. The cardinality of $\mathcal{M}(g)$ is established for all odd primes $p$.
